findings.message: Section 5.4 (Host checks) still says without qualification: "Inline merge reruns triggered hard entries on the rebased candidate. The `serve` merge queue (section 7.2) runs the hard entries named in `merge.safety_checks` at safety and every always/hard entry at integration." After this diff, both reruns are skipped for a nonempty branch when main changed only `tickets/` paths since the reviewed merge base. The doc therefore states the old behavior.
findings.paved_road: Qualify the section 5.4 sentences: inline merge and the serve queue's safety host checks and integration tier rerun only when main changed a path outside `tickets/` since the reviewed merge base, or when the branch diff is empty. Otherwise only the Merge gates run (see sections 4.5 and 7.2.1).
